title: Uruguayan Cheddar Frittata
description: A classic Uruguayan-inspired frittata, perfect for breakfast or brunch. This recipe combines the rich flavors of roasted cheddar and Uruguayan flair.
instructions: In a large skillet, sauté the chopped parsley until wilted.
In a large bowl, whisk together eggs, milk, salt, and pepper.
Add the roasted cheddar cheese to the bowl and stir to combine.
Pour the egg mixture over the cooked parsley in the skillet.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the eggs are set.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Use a spatula to carefully loosen the edges of the frittata from the skillet.
Slide the frittata onto a plate and serve hot.
